summary: Sphere 3D Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with A.G.P. and added Maxim Group as a second sales agent. The new agreement allows sales of common shares up to $10.3 million, replacing the prior $8 million ATM facility, under which 2,172,789 shares were sold for gross proceeds of about $5.13 million through July 30, 2026. The prior prospectus supplement was terminated. This is a routine equity facility amendment, not a special situation, as it solely updates an existing capital-raising arrangement without change in control, premium, or strategic event.
